candidates.title: Best Paper Award
candidates.issuer: ECIR (29th European Conference on Information Retrieval)
candidates.description: Best Paper Award at the 29th ECIR 2007, received while a researcher at ISTI-CNR Pisa (announced in a CNR institutional news item titled "Best Paper Award alla 29th ECIR 2007 - premiato Fabrizio Silvestri Ricercatore Isti CNR").

notes: Only one award could be independently verified via an institutional web page before the web_search quota was exhausted (CNR news item confirming ECIR 2007 Best Paper Award). Several additional leads surfaced in search listings but could not be opened/verified in this session and should be followed up by a human reviewer: (1) the DIAG Sapienza faculty page (https://www.diag.uniroma1.it/users/fabrizio_silvestri) and the Sapienza PhD page (https://phd.uniroma1.it/web/FABRIZIO-SILVESTRI_nC2927_EN.aspx), which typically list awards in the bio; (2) the RSTLess Lab bio (https://rstless-lab.netlify.app/authors/silvestri/); (3) the ECIR 2024 awards page (https://www.ecir2024.org/awards/) — Silvestri was involved with ECIR 2024 and may appear as a recipient or in an award committee role (service, which would not count); (4) possible Yahoo Labs internal recognitions and Meta/Facebook internal recognition programs from his industry years, which rarely have public URLs. The sandbox had no outbound HTTP (curl was blocked), so page bodies could not be fetched directly; verification relied on search-snippet metadata. The namesake Italian journalist/filmmaker was filtered out — none of the returned hits matched that profile.
